evidence.source_page: (per source document)

evidence.commercial_use: (Qualified review and above.) Production scheduling scenario, subject to material-balance review and flotation test work.

evidence.claim: Entry & Validation Access requires a USD 150,000 Non-Refundable Entry Fee payable to Atlas Mining.
evidence.source_page: (per source document)
evidence.source_quote_or_summary: Entry & Validation Access requires a USD 150,000 Non-Refundable Entry Fee payable to Atlas Mining.
evidence.validation_notes: SEVERE — mischaracterizing the fee creates legal and reputational exposure.

evidence.claim: The license is not being sold; the standard offer is structured operating entry and validation access.
evidence.source_page: (per source document)
evidence.source_quote_or_summary: The license is not being sold; the standard offer is structured operating entry and validation access.
evidence.validation_notes: SEVERE — implying license sale contradicts the core commercial architecture.
evidence.commercial_use: Atlas Mining preserves license control; any transfer, equity, or operating right is separately negotiated and documented.
evidence.recommended_label: Atlas-controlled opportunity

evidence.claim: The ATLAS Intelligent Copper Targeting System is an independent decision-support layer (Akanil technology structure), separate from the entry fee.
evidence.source_page: (per source document)
evidence.source_quote_or_summary: The ATLAS Intelligent Copper Targeting System is an independent decision-support layer (Akanil technology structure), separate from the entry fee.
evidence.validation_notes: High — bundling the system with the fee breaks a binding separation rule.
evidence.commercial_use: An optional, independent digital validation layer that reduces blind exploration and supports pilot-feed definition. It does not replace geologists, engineers, labs, legal review, or feasibility studies.
evidence.recommended_label: Independent digital layer

evidence.claim: The license may hold upside beyond the preliminary orientation case (larger mineralized system hypothesis; possible Cu/Zn extension; additional zones).
evidence.source_page: (per source document)

evidence.validation_notes: SEVERE — inventing upside tonnage/grade would be fabrication.
evidence.commercial_use: Potential upside beyond the preliminary orientation case — subject to geophysics, drilling, and resource validation; not yet resource-classified.
evidence.recommended_label: Upside case — not yet resource-classified

evidence.claim: After validation, the project may support staged industrial development: selective pilot → modular processing → staged production → plant decision → long-term operating agreement.
evidence.source_page: (per source document)
evidence.source_quote_or_summary: After validation, the project may support staged industrial development: selective pilot → modular processing → staged production → plant decision → long-term operating agreement.
evidence.commercial_use: Expansion case — staged development pathway requiring feasibility and engineering validation.
